content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto means leveraging blockchain technology to conduct transactions without relying on platforms that charge excessive fees or impose barriers. With conventional payment processors, creators face high transaction costs—Gumroad, for example, takes 10% on every sale. By utilizing NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, creators retain significantly more revenue, allowing them to invest back into their work. This shift not only maximizes income but also aligns with a growing preference for decentralized financial solutions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling Notion templates involves several key components working together seamlessly. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, creators can establish a fast and reliable online presence. The backend logic can be handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automated order processing. Payment verification is done through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This architecture ensures that creators maintain complete control over their digital products while benefiting from low transactional fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where traditional payment platforms have failed them. These creators include authors, educators, and designers who produce ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products. By providing a sovereign commerce stack, COREMERCH empowers these entrepreneurs to monetize their skills without the limitations imposed by conventional financial systems. This approach enables them to reach a global audience efficiently.
Retain 921 more dollars per month by choosing NOWPayments over Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign digital commerce stack consists of multiple components that work in harmony. Hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare ensures reliability and speed. The backend processes orders through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle logic and workflows efficiently. Order data is stored securely in Supabase or Google Sheets, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is utilized for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto transactions, providing instant payment verification. This integrated system gives creators a complete solution without dependence on external platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website hosting. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Store your order data in Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure your digital products are securely hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. For those seeking a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything needed for deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Empower your sales without the constraints of conventional payment processors.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your site. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets for easy access. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to enable automatic crypto payment processing. Review your setup to ensure everything is functional before launching your store.
